LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingRemoteContro: Remote control of vehicles by radio

On by default. A vehicle fitted with a control radio can be driven from a radio station with nobody aboard: draft it and give it orders as usual. If it loses its link, it waits a few seconds and then does what you chose for it: hold, come back toward its station, or finish its last drive. Off, no vehicle is driven from a station, and one already driving stops where it is.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_GizmoDriveDesc: Lets a radio station drive this vehicle while nobody is at its wheel: once a station has it, draft it and give it orders as usual. It holds a control channel at that station while this is on, and a colonist at the wheel still drives it the ordinary way. Turn it off to park it and free the channel.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_GizmoLostHold: If the link is lost: hold
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_GizmoLostComeBack: If the link is lost: come back
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_GizmoLostCarryOn: If the link is lost: carry on
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_GizmoLostDesc: What this vehicle does when a station loses touch with it while driving it, after waiting a few seconds in case the link comes back. Click to choose.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_ChoiceHold: Hold: stop where it is and wait for the link
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_ChoiceComeBack: Come back: drive toward the station until the link returns
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_ChoiceCarryOn: Carry on: finish the drive it was given, then wait
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_InspectUnlinked: Driven from a station: waiting for a station to reach it.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_InspectWaiting: Driven from a station: link lost, carrying on for a few seconds.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_InspectHolding: Link lost: holding here until a station reaches it.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_InspectComingBack: Link lost: coming back toward its station.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_InspectCarryingOn: Link lost: finishing its last drive.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_InspectCrew: Someone is at the wheel, so no station drives it.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_LostText: {VEHICLE} has lost its link to the station that was driving it. {ACTION}
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_LostHold: It is holding where it stands until a station reaches it again.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_LostComeBack: It is driving back toward its station until the link returns.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_LostCarryOn: It is finishing the drive it was given, and will wait there.
LanguageData.PhobosRemote_FoundText: A station is in touch with {VEHICLE} again, and can drive it.
